name: Druddigon

abilities.name: Rough Skin
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavor:
Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips
sunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its body
gets too cold.
